_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and, being the wider of the two (D7), sizes the one sensor — which is also the audience interaction.ambient fans out to. The pre-merge aggroRadius 1.0 stayed as authored but no longer governs anything: under D21 leaving talk range now ENDS a conversation, and 1.0 leaves less standing room than the two bodies take up (L26). experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. Teaches Recover and SummonTotem. Shares the Hermit sprite (entityType override). ⚑ QUESTS (plan-quests.md C4): the SHAMAN leg of D9's branch — `wolves-on-the-road` carry_word → told_shaman, rewarding Slow (until now a BanditRanged-only drop) + 400 XP. The CityGuard carries the other leg, to a different stage with a different reward. He stands by the road at (18, 6), most of the map short of the city gate — that distance IS the trade the crier names.
name: Shaman

lines: You've the smell of the forest road on you, and it isn't the good half of it.

options.text: The wolves on the west road. Eight of them are dealt with.

grants.line: Eight. And not one of them born bolder than its mother. Wolves leave a forest when something worse walks into it — remember that, the next time someone counts corpses and calls it solved.
Take this instead of my thanks. The grass will hold onto their legs for you, and you will not have to be faster than anything.
You listened to the end. That is rarer than a dead wolf.

lines: Let nature guide you. But also be aware of nature. It's complicated.

grants.line: Nature mends what it can. Breathe, and let this close your wounds.
You look like you could use some help. Take this Totem to aid you.
